answer.explanation: Within 03:16:43Z–03:26:43Z no error, exception, timeout, throttle or access-denied messages appear in any of the four functions' logs. Every REPORT line shows the same memory size as the prior baseline: CrudApi 256 MB, Uploader 256 MB, Thumbnailer 1024 MB, Compression 1024 MB. Durations and peak memory match the hourly baseline (Compression about 540 ms average, Thumbnailer about 105 ms, Uploader about 100 ms, CrudApi about 35 ms). The one notable value is a single 5549 ms Compression invocation at about 03:16:43, which is an isolated outlier with no accompanying errors and is not a sustained configuration change.
